source_claim: SEGA's official Valkyria Chronicles collaboration article identifies six campaign members as characters of the Valkyria Chronicles series and gives their named character profiles: Alicia Melchiott, Edy Nelson, Juliana Eberhardt, Selvaria Bles, Riela Marcellis, and Imca. The collaboration appearance is used only as publisher identification of the originating series, not as a second HOME.
notes: All six exact in-campaign names explicitly listed in this source are included. The page describes them as Valkyria Chronicles series characters while reporting a separate Chain Chronicle collaboration; no HOME is inferred from the guest appearance itself.
